origin.question: A falsifiable question from evidence, a desired property or a mechanism hypothesis
origin.hypothesis: The initial core hypothesis connecting the design to that question
origin.selection_rationale: Cite supporting evidence and explain why this question matters
origin.delta: Substantive method difference from the Parent and closest methods
origin.falsification_criteria: Results that would weaken the core hypothesis
origin.parent_response: Explain the Parent connection and motivation; cite a real parent question only when directly addressing it
origin.engineering_review: Applicable Engineering evidence and reuse/defer decisions, or unavailable reports

design.predictions: Separate mechanism, quality and complete-cycle cost predictions
design.tests: Matched comparator, observable discriminator and falsification conditions
